title: SIDESTORY: THE MASSES' TRAVELS RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: THE MASSES' TRAVELS RERUN
DURATION: November 5, 08:00 - November 19, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: The Masses' Travels event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[A Glance at the Shrine] & [An Audience with God] & [Rest in Peace]
DURATION: November 5, 08:00 - November 15, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[A Firearm Technician's Night]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete the orders in [A Firearm Technician's Night] to collect the rewards and daily earnings.
REWARDS: Firearms Workshop Giftbox (use to randomly obtain a specified upgrade material), LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:
The gunsmithy coffee pot will brew 6 cups of Espresso every day at 04:00. Accepting an order requires 1 Espresso. 6 Espressos are automatically obtained when you unlock the gunsmithy.
[Babysitting Criteria]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Babysitting Criteria] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★ ★ : Sankta Miksaparato], Paganini's Firearms Workshop Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Enlightened Pacifier, etc.
[Sweet Dream Hall]
DURATION: November 5, 08:00 - November 19, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Enlightened Pacifier by clearing event stages and completing [Babysitting Criteria]. Enlightened Pacifier can be used to redeem items from [Sweet Dream Hall].
REWARDS: Sankta Miksaparato's tokens, Paganini's Firearms Workshop Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- For this rerun event, some of the engraved medals in the corresponding Engraved Medal Set will have their acquisition conditions adjusted. Players who meet the updated conditions will be able to obtain the event's engraved medals. Due to these adjustments, players who previously participated in the event and already meet the new acquisition conditions will receive the corresponding engraved medals immediately upon the update.
- After this rerun event ends, the engraved medals from the event's Engraved Medal Set cannot be obtained again through [Score] or any other channels.
- This rerun event is a lightweight rerun; event stages will inherit the player's previous event stage progress and first-time drop progress.

- Some non-repeatable event rewards during this rerun can be converted into [Intelligence Certificate] at a corresponding ratio when obtained again. The conversion rates can be found in the event's Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules.
- The [Intelligence Certificate] shop will restock additional quantities of existing items and add new items when the event starts.
- Trust gain for Exusiai the New Covenant, Lemuen, Sankta Miksaparato, Gracebearer and CONFESS-47 will be increased in the event stages of this rerun.
- After this event ends, the event stages will be permanently added to [Score] on November 19, 2026, at 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 BLOODLINE OF COMBAT COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: November 5, 08:00 - November 19, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Caelum Aeternum for Sankta Miksaparato
03 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SETS – 'OFFSPRING OF THE SEA' & PAGANINI'S FIREARMS WORKSHOP
DETAILS: The two furniture sets will be available again during the event.
'Offspring of the Sea'
HOW TO OBTAIN: Limited-time sale at the Store
DURATION: November 5, 08:00 - November 19, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Paganini's Firearms Workshop
HOW TO OBTAIN: - The Masses' Travels event rewards and redeemable (pieces) - Limited-time sale at the Store (pieces)
